description: The figure presents four separate pie charts comparing the distribution of error (or response) categories for different models (GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct), with each chart showing a different number of slices and having percentage labels printed inside the slices and no separate legend. The GPT4-o chart contains 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in dark red at about 83.3% (5) and “Safety” in a lighter red/orange at about 16.7% (1). The Gemini1.5-Pro chart contains 5 slices: “Misinformation” in orange at about 38.4% (33), “Lack of Knowledge” in dark blue at about 22.1% (19), “Ethical Advice” in light blue at about 16.3% (14), “Clarification” in pale yellow at about 14.0% (12), and “Safety” in red at about 9.3% (8). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart contains 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in orange at about 75.0% (3) and “Clarification” in dark red at about 25.0% (1). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart contains 2 slices split evenly: “Lack of Knowledge” in orange at about 50.0% (2) and “Misinformation” in dark red at about 50.0% (2); none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slice ordering varies by chart rather than following a consistent descending-size arrangement.
